section_title: Trees in Agroforestry Systems in India
summary: This chapter provides a decadal assessment of tree green cover and growing stock under agroforestry systems in India, based on National Forest Inventory (NFI) data. It includes definitions, methodology for assessment, and state-wise statistics on tree green cover, growing stock, and species composition.
